استأيكت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْيَكْتُ (istaʔyaktu) /is.taʔ.jak.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# اِسْتَأْيَكْتَ (istaʔyakta) /is.taʔ.jak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# اِسْتَأْيَكْتِ (istaʔyakti) /is.taʔ.jak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# اِسْتَأْيَكَتْ (istaʔyakat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
